patterns: APPSC asks direct facts: tenure 6 years or 65 (APPSC 2022), longest term vs President/VP/MP (G2 2017), annual report submitted to President (G1).
Recurring trap: 'CAG controls the entire financial system' is the wrong statement (G2 2017); UPSC-style 'CAG is only an Auditor General, no exchequer control'.
Article numbers (148 appointment, 149 duties), Second/Third Schedule, removal like SC judge, leave granted by President are standard one-liners.
PAC linkage: CAG as 'friend, philosopher and guide', PAC reports to Speaker/Parliament, chair from Opposition.
App MCQs add many Statement-A/B and assertion items plus 2026 current-affairs (Report No. 31, 101 cities) and tenure comparisons of other offices beyond PYQ depth.
